messages.en:
{07 14 00}How did you guess that's
my favorite thing in the
house, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kuidas sa arvasid, et see
on mu lemmikasi terves
majas, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
You know good furniture
when you see it, {07 0b 00}don't
you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 0d 00}I'm glad you appreciate the
finer things in life, even
if they're MY things!
messages.et:
Sa tunned hea mööbli ära,
kui seda näed, {07 0b 00}kas pole,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 0d 00}Hea meel, et sa hindad elu
peenemaid asju, isegi kui
nad on MINU asjad!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}What, that? You've got your
eye on that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}?
I can't get rid of that!
{07 0a 00}That's, like, one of my
top-three favorite things
in the house, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mis, seda? Sul on sellele
silm peal, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}?
Ma ei saa sellest loobuda!
{07 0a 00}See on üks mu kolmest
lemmikasjast terves
majas, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
